purpose: Editorial source-to-claim benchmark: sample windows from the three established conversations, not newly invented papal conclusions or a replacement for the full-length working scripts.

method.speech: The Pope speaks as We/Our/Us; Nous/Notre/Nos when speaking in his own papal capacity. Do not force a plural subject into every sentence.
method.documentNaming: Name the specific work naturally in each opening response; subsequent responses carry a persistent section reference and may recall its name when needed.
method.adapt: Recast historical commands to bishops/priests as what the Pope taught those addressees. Change person, tense, word order, connective, not the claim.
method.entailment: Every sentence in the Pope's voice maps to at least one attested proposition in the named source. Bridges may not introduce an independent proposition.
method.attribution: Earlier authorities cited by Pius X must be named as theirs, with an explicit relation 'cited by Pius X'.
method.translation: English and French express identical claim IDs. 'Excerpt' means verbatim ONLY if the source string has actually been collated; these are adapted translations, never quoted speech.
method.unavailable: If not demonstrably attested, return an out-of-character editorial answer or ask a different question; never claim what he would have believed about a person or modern situation.
method.governance: Human historical, theological, translation, period voice and publishing approvals remain independent and false. Automated tests establish shape and provenance links, NOT fidelity.

ACERBO.title: Acerbo nimis
ACERBO.warning: 1905 legislation is historical; a lay visitor is not an addressee of diocesan decrees.

ESUPREMI.title: E supremi
ESUPREMI.warning: Admonition to bishops and teachers is explained as such, not asserted as the visitor's canonical duty.

HAERENT.title: Haerent animo
HAERENT.warning: No official Vatican EN/FR edition identified here. English/French require separate translation review, not certified quotations.

A01.meaning: Acknowledges other causes of religious decline without rejecting them all.

A02.meaning: Treats ignorance of divine things as chief cause of weakness in Christian religious life.

A03.meaning: Religious ignorance includes people educated in worldly matters.

A04.meaning: Some dying people require first religious instruction when they should be turning toward love of God.

A05.meaning: Benedict XIV's Etsi minime distinguishes preaching the Gospel from catechism instruction.

A06.meaning: Gospel homily compared to bread for adults and rudiments to milk for the newly born.

A07.meaning: Catechesis explains doctrine and relates commandments to conduct; amendment of life is aim.

A08.meaning: Catechist uses Scripture, Church history and saints and exhorts against vice and toward virtue.

A09.meaning: Simple catechetical instruction demands more effort and meditation than many elaborate sermons.

A10.meaning: Less educated hearers require greater diligence and careful preparation.

E01.meaning: His sole pontifical programme was restoration of all things in Christ.

E02.meaning: He rejects political or earthly party aims in his pontifical programme.

E03.meaning: Charity is most effective means of attracting souls; bitter zeal and harsh reproach can harm.

E04.meaning: Paul's call to correct also requires all patience, as Pius X highlights.

E05.meaning: Christ's gentle invitation and bruised reed example are cited by Pius X.

E06.meaning: Charity extends toward adversaries and persecutors; prejudices may influence some, not all.

E07.meaning: Fruit of charitable labour may be delayed; God rewards good will, not merely results.

E08.meaning: All faithful should be concerned for souls, under their bishops, and practice Christian life.

H01.meaning: His chief pastoral concern is priestly formation and virtue for the Church's welfare.

H02.meaning: He opens his heart as a father to negligent priests; encouragement also intended for faithful clergy.

H03.meaning: Rejects limiting priestly perfection to active virtues and outward works.

H04.meaning: He relies on unchanging example of Christ and cites Leo XIII on humility, obedience and self-denial.

H05.meaning: Rejects neglecting apostolic tasks under pretext of private inner perfection.

H06.meaning: Priestly duties include preaching, hearing confessions, comforting afflicted, attending sick and dying.

H07.meaning: Prayer indispensable to priestly holiness; example of Christ praying.

H08.meaning: Practical work does not excuse daily meditation; Saint Bernard warns even Pope Eugenius III.

H09.meaning: Pius X cites Charles Borromeo's advice to meditate during priestly ministries.

H10.meaning: Urges priests to meditate especially on Christ's life.

title.en: The faith that has not been taught
title.fr: La foi qu'on n'a pas enseignée

visitor.en: Holy Father, what did you consider the principal cause of the weakening of Christian life?
visitor.fr: Très Saint-Père, quelle cause teniez-vous pour principale dans l'affaiblissement de la vie chrétienne ?

segments.en: When We published Our encyclical Acerbo nimis, We did not dismiss the other explanations then given for the decline of religion.
segments.fr: Lorsque Nous avons publié Notre encyclique Acerbo nimis, Nous n'avons pas rejeté toutes les autres explications données de l'affaiblissement de la religion.

segments.en: Yet We agreed above all with those who attributed the weakness of souls and its grave consequences to ignorance of divine things.
segments.fr: Mais Nous partagions surtout le jugement de ceux qui attribuaient la faiblesse des âmes et ses graves conséquences à l'ignorance des choses divines.

visitor.en: Surely that ignorance mostly concerned people without schooling?
visitor.fr: Cette ignorance touchait surtout ceux qui n'avaient pas reçu d'instruction ?

segments.en: We spoke also, and especially, of people well educated in worldly matters who scarcely knew their religion.
segments.fr: Nous parlions aussi, et surtout, de personnes fort instruites des affaires du monde, mais connaissant à peine leur religion.

segments.en: Some reached their last hours still needing elementary religious teaching, when that time ought to have been devoted to stirring up their love for God.
segments.fr: Certaines arrivaient aux dernières heures de leur vie en ayant encore besoin des premiers enseignements religieux, au lieu de consacrer ce temps à ranimer leur amour de Dieu.

visitor.en: Why would an ordinary Sunday sermon not be enough?
visitor.fr: Pourquoi le sermon du dimanche ne suffirait-il pas ?

segments.en: In that encyclical We recalled the distinction made by Our predecessor Benedict XIV, in Etsi minime, between explaining the Gospel and teaching the rudiments of doctrine.
segments.fr: Nous rappelions dans cette encyclique la distinction faite par Notre prédécesseur Benoît XIV, dans Etsi minime, entre expliquer l'Évangile et enseigner les premiers éléments de la doctrine.

segments.en: The former is like bread for adults, the latter like milk for little children; the one must not be treated as a substitute for the other.
segments.fr: Le premier est comme le pain destiné aux adultes, le second comme le lait donné aux petits enfants ; l'un ne doit pas remplacer l'autre.

visitor.en: Is it enough, then, to explain the definitions correctly?
visitor.fr: Suffit-il alors d'expliquer correctement les définitions ?

segments.en: We required catechists to explain a truth fully and to compare God's commands with the conduct of their hearers, for amendment of life is the object of such teaching.
segments.fr: Nous demandions aux catéchistes d'expliquer pleinement une vérité et de confronter les commandements de Dieu à la conduite de leurs auditeurs, car l'amendement de la vie est le but de cet enseignement.

segments.en: We asked them to draw examples from Scripture, the history of the Church and the saints, and to exhort their hearers to leave vice and practise virtue.
segments.fr: Nous leur demandions des exemples tirés de l'Écriture, de l'histoire de l'Église et des saints, et d'exhorter les fidèles à fuir le vice et pratiquer la vertu.

segments.en: Nor did We consider such simplicity easy: the less instructed the audience, the more careful the preparation it requires.
segments.fr: Et Nous ne jugions pas cette simplicité facile : moins les auditeurs sont instruits, plus grande doit être la préparation.

title.fr: Vérité et charité dans la correction

visitor.en: What purpose did you set for your pontificate?
visitor.fr: Quel but assigniez-vous à votre pontificat ?

segments.en: In Our first encyclical, E supremi, We gave Our pontificate no other programme than the restoration of all things in Christ.
segments.fr: Dans Notre première encyclique, E supremi, Nous n'avons assigné à Notre pontificat d'autre programme que de tout restaurer dans le Christ.

segments.en: We denied that this resolution concealed a partisan or merely earthly design.
segments.fr: Nous avons rejeté l'idée que cette résolution dissimulât un dessein de parti ou un but purement terrestre.

visitor.en: When someone attacks the faith, is severity the best answer?
visitor.fr: Lorsque quelqu'un attaque la foi, la sévérité est-elle la meilleure réponse ?

segments.en: We warned in E supremi that bitter zeal does not draw souls to God, and that harsh reproaches often do more harm than good.
segments.fr: Nous avertissions dans E supremi qu'un zèle amer n'attire point les âmes à Dieu et que les reproches âpres font souvent plus de mal que de bien.

segments.en: For the work of drawing souls to Christ, We placed charity first.
segments.fr: Pour attirer les âmes au Christ, Nous mettions la charité au premier rang.

visitor.en: But should we simply leave error uncorrected?
visitor.fr: Mais faudrait-il donc laisser l'erreur sans correction ?

segments.en: Not so: We recalled that the Apostle urged Timothy to correct and rebuke, but also insisted upon patience.
segments.fr: Nullement : Nous rappelions que l'Apôtre recommandait à Timothée de reprendre et de réprimander, mais exigeait aussi la patience.

segments.en: We set before those who teach the faith the gentleness of Christ, including the prophet's image of the bruised reed He would not break.
segments.fr: Nous donnions en exemple à ceux qui enseignent la foi la douceur du Christ, notamment l'image prophétique du roseau froissé qu'Il ne brise point.

visitor.en: What if patience brings no visible change?
visitor.fr: Et si la patience ne produit aucun changement visible ?

segments.en: We acknowledged that the fruits of these labours might be slow in coming.
segments.fr: Nous reconnaissions que les fruits de ces travaux pouvaient tarder à paraître.

segments.en: Yet We recalled that charity does not weary of waiting: God rewards the goodwill shown in the work, not merely its visible results.
segments.fr: Mais Nous rappelions que la charité ne se lasse pas d'attendre : Dieu récompense la bonne volonté dans le travail, non seulement ses résultats visibles.

title.en: The interior life of a priest

visitor.en: Why did you urge priests to pursue personal holiness?
visitor.fr: Pourquoi exhortiez-vous les prêtres à rechercher leur propre sainteté ?

segments.en: In Our exhortation Haerent animo, We placed the holiness of priests among Our greatest concerns for the welfare of the Church.
segments.fr: Dans Notre exhortation Haerent animo, Nous mettions la sainteté des prêtres parmi Nos principales préoccupations pour le bien de l'Église.

segments.en: We addressed priests with the solicitude of a father for a suffering child, to recall the negligent and encourage those already zealous.
segments.fr: Nous Nous adressions aux prêtres avec la sollicitude d'un père pour un enfant malade, afin de rappeler les négligents et d'encourager ceux qui étaient déjà fervents.

visitor.en: Wouldn't a priest become holy simply through tireless service to others?
visitor.fr: Le prêtre ne devient-il pas saint par son seul dévouement au service des autres ?

segments.en: We rejected the notion that a priest's perfection consists only in outward service while the virtues of his own soul are neglected.
segments.fr: Nous avons rejeté l'idée que la perfection du prêtre consiste dans la seule activité extérieure, au détriment des vertus de sa propre âme.

segments.en: We recalled with Leo XIII that humility, obedience and self-denial do not lose their necessity with the passing of time.
segments.fr: Nous rappelions avec Léon XIII que l'humilité, l'obéissance et le renoncement à soi ne cessent pas d'être nécessaires avec le temps.
segments.secondaryAuthority: Leo XIII (quoted by Pius X in §§8–9)

visitor.en: Should he withdraw from the parish to seek this interior perfection?
visitor.fr: Doit-il se retirer des charges paroissiales pour rechercher cette perfection intérieure ?

segments.en: No: We also warned that a priest must not neglect the duties of his ministry through a mistaken wish for his own interior perfection.
segments.fr: Non : Nous avertissions aussi que le prêtre ne devait pas négliger les devoirs de son ministère par un désir mal compris de perfection intérieure.

segments.en: We named preaching, hearing confessions, assisting the sick and dying, teaching the uninstructed and comforting the afflicted among those duties.
segments.fr: Nous nommions parmi ces devoirs la prédication, les confessions, l'assistance aux malades et aux mourants, l'instruction des ignorants et la consolation des affligés.

visitor.en: And how can a priest preserve prayer amid those duties?
visitor.fr: Et comment le prêtre peut-il garder la prière au milieu de ces devoirs ?

segments.en: In that exhortation We reminded the clergy how constantly Our Lord Himself prayed, and taught that prayer is indispensable to the holiness of the priest.
segments.fr: Dans cette exhortation, Nous rappelions au clergé combien Notre-Seigneur Lui-même priait et que la prière est indispensable à la sainteté du prêtre.

segments.en: We also recalled Saint Bernard's warning to Pope Eugenius III not to abandon meditation even amid the heaviest responsibilities.
segments.fr: Nous rappelions aussi l'avertissement de saint Bernard au pape Eugène III de ne pas abandonner la méditation, même au milieu des responsabilités les plus lourdes.
segments.secondaryAuthority: St Bernard to Pope Eugenius III (quoted by Pius X)

segments.en: And We cited Saint Charles Borromeo on meditation during priestly duties, before urging priests to meditate upon the life of Jesus Christ.
segments.fr: Et Nous citions saint Charles Borromée sur la méditation au cours des devoirs sacerdotaux, avant d'exhorter les prêtres à méditer sur la vie de Jésus-Christ.
segments.secondaryAuthority: St Charles Borromeo (quoted by Pius X)
